subject: Trading
title: The Bid-Ask Spread
description: Learn The Bid-Ask Spread in one minute.

hook.text: There's no single price for a stock. There are always two: the bid and the ask. The gap is the spread.

buildup.text: The bid is the highest price a buyer will pay. The ask is the lowest price a seller will accept.

discovery.text: A trade happens when a buyer agrees to pay the ask, or a seller accepts the bid. The spread is the cost.

twist.text: Tight spreads mean liquid markets. Wide spreads mean less liquidity and higher hidden trading costs.

climax.text: The spread is where market makers earn their profit—and where traders quietly lose money on every trade.

punchline.text: Every trade costs you the spread.

quiz.question: What is the bid-ask spread?
options: The gap between the highest buy price and lowest sell price
